## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squash commit)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and, if relevant, `npm run test:pg` / `npm run test:ui` pass
- [ ] Docs and the **Unreleased** section of `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
